controls.gate: if any random control passes or the planted control fails, nothing is proven in this re-test
controls.invariance: for every re-tested id the Rs-1-lakh twin computed in the same pass must equal its stored corrected-data DISCOVERY row (trades, gross, cost, net per half); mismatches are listed and such ids cannot be proven
controls.placebo: audit_run's 10 random-entry intraday controls (RAND_TIME30_s1..5, RAND_BRACKET05_s1..5) at Rs 5 lakh on DISCOVERY: expected to FAIL the screen (no information); the count that passes is reported
controls.planted: audit_run's CHEAT_LOOKAHEAD_30BARS (a planted look-ahead edge) at Rs 5 lakh on DISCOVERY: must PASS the screen (the pipeline can see an edge at this size)

data: the corrected view (stratlab/corrected.py, corr1) exactly as prereg/rerun_corrected_v1.json: 2023-26 minute bars of the 97 NIFTY-100 names (survivorship-biased), 2016-23 corrected old minute view with its dirty-link rule, 2012-23 corrected daily file with point-in-time NIFTY 100 membership

dsr.N: 4979 (every trial so far: lab 2,552 + 16 builder development evaluations + 2,400 builder candidates + 11 builder FINAL looks = the builder registry's N after batch 0006) + K (396) + the number of FINAL looks opened by this re-test
dsr.V: max(robust (1.4826 x MAD)^2 variance of the K re-tested strategies' DISCOVERY daily Sharpes at the new size (ids with >= 1 trade), 1 / (T_days - 1)) - the builder's convention
dsr.formula: trials.dsr (Bailey & Lopez de Prado): daily Sharpe, skew, non-excess kurtosis
dsr.report_only: the same DSR with the ledger's robust V of the Rs 1 lakh screens (0.029145)
dsr.series: daily net P&L (trials.daily_pnl convention: booked on the exit session) of DISCOVERY + FINAL, 2023-11-10 .. 2026-11-09, at the new size

final.rule: ONE look per DISCOVERY passer at the new size, written once to size10l/final_ledger.json (first write wins); CONFIRMED = net > 0 and PF >= 1.05

judgement.no_softening: 0 proven is reported as 0; near misses are listed as failures

old_era.daily_2012_23: where protocol_oos.eligibility() allows: protocol_oos.judge gates unchanged, corrected daily file, PIT NIFTY 100, new size; REPORTED next to the minute judgement (the OOS gate is the 2016-23 minute judgement, as in the corrected re-run's definition of proven)
old_era.minute_2016_23: for every FINAL-confirmed strategy: protocol_min_oos gates unchanged (fingerprint bf4933d2c1f1) on the corrected old minute view, new size, base 2 bps + its 5 bps sensitivity pass; one judgement, size10l/oldera_min_ledger.json. OOS-CONFIRMED = all gates met.

judgement.proven: DISCOVERY gates passed AND FINAL CONFIRMED AND 2016-23 minute OOS-CONFIRMED AND DSR >= 0.95 (N, V above) AND the controls behave (below). The lab's earlier bar for catalogue strategies (FINAL-CONFIRMED + OOS-CONFIRMED, without the DSR) is reported as its own line, labelled.

results_seen_at_writing.known: an approximate fee-only rescaling of the BUILDER's 2,400 candidates' DISCOVERY totals (about 19 more intraday and 19 more scalping candidates net-positive in both halves); no catalogue strategy was re-costed or re-run at the new size before this file

verification.what: the size wrapper forced to Rs 1 lakh reproduces the stored corrected-data DISCOVERY rows (trades, gross, cost, net per half) of three strategies exactly

title: Old lab catalogue re-tested at the Rs 10 lakh-per-agent trade size (Rs 5 lakh per intraday / stock-futures trade)

trials.counted: each of the K re-tests is a NEW trial (ledger id 'sz10l:<id>', stages size10l-screen / size10l-final / size10l-oos); nothing is hidden
trials.second_look: the FINAL (2025-12-17 .. 2026-11-09) and old-era windows of these strategies were already looked at once at Rs 1 lakh (and again by the corrected-data recomputation). The re-test is a second, strongly correlated look at the same windows with one pre-fixed change (the size). It is counted in N; it is not an independent confirmation.

why: User: 'Each agent 10 lac capital testing the All strategies' and 'Add old lab catalogue strategies also'. The catalogue was tested at Rs 1 lakh per stock trade, where the flat Rs 20-per-order brokerage is about half of an intraday round trip's fees. This file freezes how the re-test at the larger size is done and judged, before any Rs-5-lakh result is computed.
